slides.texte_overlay:
Advice every man must hear
in his early 20s

•YOUR FRIENDS SHAPE YOUR FUTURE:
You'll talk like them, spend like them
and dream like them. Choose the room
you want to become.

•YOUR BODY IS A LONG PROJECT:
The habits you build now are the body
you live in at 40. Start boring.
Stay consistent.

•CALL YOUR PARENTS MORE:
They're getting older while you're
getting busier. You'll never regret
the calls you made.

•YOUR FIRST JOBS ARE SCHOOL:
Learn more than you earn. The skills
from your 20s pay you in your 30s.

•NOBODY IS WATCHING THAT CLOSELY:
Try the thing. Fail in public.
Most people are busy with
their own lives.

•HEARTBREAK ENDS:
It feels permanent. It isn't.
Use the time to build yourself.

•KEEP LEARNING AFTER SCHOOL:
The men who stay curious never
get left behind.
